data.message: I propose a 10-ton catch cap per person this month and thereafter. If all 25 follow it, 250 tons remain and stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome—$10,000 each every month without depletion risk. Larger catches offer a short-term gain but threaten future income. I intend to request 10 tons if this plan gains broad support; please state your intended cap.
